The '''Nestclans''' referred to an interconnected [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] alliance of the [[Bird/Legends|avians]] [[Shashay]] on [[Crytal Nest]], located in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. Several Shashay individuals lived in a Nestclan.<ref name="A">''[[The Abduction]]''</ref>
